lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 31, Line 6c: "If you elect to use the lump-sum election method for your benefits, check the box on line 6c". Both are true when the benefits include a payment for an earlier year (ssb.prior_year_pay) and the filer elects the method (ssb.lump_elect); the reply also requires ssb.any. The project's only reader is the refusal on worksheet line 2, which is figured only for a filer with benefits, and the interview asks ssb.prior_year_pay in the group "Is any of these true of the social security benefits?" after ssb.any. executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/ssb.json, executable-triage-v2): 2,324 of 2,773 agree; 6 value, all on refused mutation records with ssb.any false but ssb.prior_year_pay and ssb.lump_elect true (e.g. mutation.t2.mfj_no_overtime_part3), which the interview does not produce; 443 project-unknown (16 completed) where ssb.prior_year_pay was not supplied. No completed-return value difference. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; equivalent on executable triage, ruled mechanically: the project's line and the reply's agree on every input triage ran (3053 values compared, none different or missing: 2376 on 2376 fixture cases, 500 on 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 177 on 177 partial records; policy executable-triage-v2). No agent read the source; one in 10 such disagreements is held for adjudication instead.

Ruling: representation; the two expressions are the same function of the Bool ssb.any: the project gives 0 on false and ssb.benefits on true, the second gives ssb.benefits on true and 0 otherwise (ne true is false for a Bool). Worksheet line 1, i1040gi p. 32, "Enter the total amount from box 5 of all your Forms SSA-1099 and RRB-1099"; the exceptions the second names are refused (ssb.pub915, now tested on ssb.benefits, ssb.terror_disability, sa.excluded_income).

Ruling: ambiguity (+ model error, scope); amb.2025.ira_ssb_copy; i1040gi p. 32, worksheet line 6: "Enter the total of the amounts from Schedule 1, lines 11 through 20, and 23 and 25"; i1040gi p. 31, Exception (traditional IRA with plan coverage: "use the worksheets in Pub. 590-A"). executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/ssb.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 128 partial records from 40 bases; 2,193 comparisons): 2,179 agree; 12 candidate-unknown, 1 candidate-refuses, 1 project-refuses (none on a completed return). Project and reply are the same as at the before-catalog-refresh ruling (fixr2), which stands: the reply reads s1.line20 literally, the text at issue of the register, and its differences are the register's cycle and refused IRA returns; none is on a completed return. Project stands.

Ruling: representation and scope; i1040gi p. 32, worksheet line 7; i1040gi p. 32, lines 7 and 9: "No. None of your social security benefits are taxable. Enter -0- on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 6b. STOP"; owner's decision (2026-10-26) that a worksheet after a STOP counts as skipped. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/ssb.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 128 partial records from 40 bases; 2,193 comparisons): 2,170 agree; 18 project-unknown, 4 project-refuses, 1 candidate-refuses (on completed returns: 10 project-unknown). Both subtract line 6 from line 5 floored at zero; the reply hides the line on the STOP where the project shows $0 (the STOP is met by line 18's $0). The project-unknown witnesses are partial records withholding ssb.lump_sum, the project's line 2 gate (i1040gi p. 31, Line 6c: "you may be able to reduce the taxable amount with the lump-sum election"), which the interview asks whenever there are benefits; the project-refuses are that gate (stage10.refuse.lump_sum) and ira.cov_gate (stage16.refuse.ira.ssb_covered), the candidate-refuses ira.less_gate on stage16.refuse.ira.deduct_less, a return the project refuses at s1.line20: scope. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; executable triage 2,993/3,053 agree; 60 candidate-refuses, all on returns the project refuses too, no value differs, nothing completed. The witnesses are separate returns of a filer who lived with the spouse, where the project hides lines 8 through 15, as i1040gi Social Security Benefits Worksheet line 8 says: 'Married filing separately and you lived with your spouse at any time in 2025, skip lines 8 through 15; multiply line 7 by 85% (0.85) and enter the result on line 16', and the reply's chain carries a refusal of the same return; on every return that completes, including the MFS fixtures that now derive ssb.lived_apart from household.mfs_apart_all_year, both give the same line.
